risks.title: REIT Regulation
risks.summary: The company must comply with REIT rules to avoid tax penalties and financial losses.
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulatory requirements as a REIT, including the obligation to distribute at least 90% of its annual taxable income. Non-compliance may result in loss of REIT status and federal, state and local taxation.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.summary: The company faces significant credit risk due to its investments in risky assets and non-performing loan portfolios.
risks.score_rationale: The company invests in risky assets, including non-agency mortgages, collateralized loan obligations (CLOs), commercial loans, and non-investment grade securities. These assets are sensitive to payment defaults and credit market fluctuations.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.summary: The company must manage risks related to market fluctuations to maintain portfolio value and financial performance.
risks.score_rationale: The company is sensitive to fluctuations in interest rates, credit spreads, real estate asset prices, and overall market volatility. These factors directly impact investment portfolio value and dividend distribution capacity.

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: The company must maintain competitiveness and relative performance to attract investors and capital in a fragmented market.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive alternative investment and asset management market, where other fund managers and REITs target the same asset classes and investment opportunities.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.summary: The company must monitor geopolitical events to anticipate impacts on financial policies and market conditions.
risks.score_rationale: The company may be affected by geopolitical events, including changes in monetary policy, housing policy adjustments, and international credit crises that influence financial markets.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: The company must maintain robust cybersecurity defenses to protect client data and operational continuity.
risks.score_rationale: Although the company relies on Ellington's and Longbridge's integrated cybersecurity processes within their risk management programs, cyberattacks could compromise client data, financial information, and critical operating systems.

risks.title: Manager Dependency
risks.summary: The company is highly dependent on Ellington's expertise and management quality to sustain performance and returns.
risks.score_rationale: The company is managed by Ellington Management, a subsidiary of Ellington. The manager has no dedicated employees and relies entirely on Ellington's staff for investment strategy, risk management, and day-to-day operations.
